### direction — not-measured

Reason: This corpus's .strums files record strum (pluck) events only; they carry no up/down direction ground truth, and docs/eval/real-audio-dsp-baseline.md computes no direction-accuracy number for this corpus (grep -rn "direction" docs/eval/*.md returns zero hits, ADR 0354 Kontextus). The 80.7% direction figure in recognition-release-guard.md is a different measurement (the live 3-class CRNN's held-out eval fold) and is not part of this 82-recording corpus.

### latency — not-measured

Reason: The baseline measurement is an offline batch run (flutter test) over pre-recorded WAV files, not a real-time on-device run, so it carries no latency measurement.

### noChord — not-measured

Reason: This corpus is ~98% major-chord phone recordings with no N.C. (no-chord) segment annotated in the ground truth, so there is no positive/negative label set to compute a no-chord accuracy against.

## BPM — RETRACTED

**This claim is retracted.** The original GOV-06 45.067 BPM figure (meanAbsoluteErrorBpm) measured pluck-density deviation against .strums-derived inter-onset intervals, not validated beat/tempo ground truth: the .strums files record individual pluck events, not tempo annotations, and implied ground-truth tempi above 200 BPM (up to 369.1 BPM) for 20 of the 82 recordings. GOV-06b (E99-R05, app commit c4ce2cc0) retracted this reading and replaced it with an independent librosa 0.11.0 beat_track reference comparison (strictTempoMatch, toleranceLevelTempoMatch below). BPM is not measurable on this corpus without validated tempo annotation. This block is kept, not deleted, so the retraction stays visible (ADR 0354 D4).
